title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.35959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Solving long-horizon agentic tasks requires language agents to interact with their environments over multiple steps, and reliable performance often comes from the expensive capable models available through cloud providers. Meanwhile, alternative efficient models with inferior performance but a much lower cost are emerging, including lower-tier cloud models and smaller open-weights models deployable on local hardware. This raises a natural question that remains less explored than traditional query-level routing: can capable and efficient models collaborate within a single long-horizon agentic task to substantially reduce cost while preserving task accuracy? In this paper, we systematically investigate key design choices for such collaboration through model handoffs, where one model takes over from another, focusing on handoff direction and context transfer. translated_title: AgentBaton：智能体任务中的高效模型协作
translated_abstract: 解决长程智能体任务需要语言智能体在多个步骤中与其环境进行交互，而可靠的性能通常依赖于云服务提供商提供的昂贵但能力强大的模型。与此同时，一些性能稍逊但成本远低的替代性高效模型正在涌现，包括较低层级的云模型以及可部署在本地硬件上的更小的开源权重模型。这引出了一个相比传统查询级路由尚未被充分探索的自然问题：能力强大的模型与高效模型能否在单个长程智能体任务内进行协作，在保持任务准确性的同时大幅降低成本？在本文中，我们通过模型交接，即一个模型接替另一个模型的方式，系统地研究了此类协作的关键设计选择，重点关注交接方向和上下文传递。我们发现，从高效模型到强大模型的交接通常表现不如仅使用强大模型……
tldr: 该论文提出AgentBaton，系统研究了在长程智能体任务中通过模型交接实现强大模型与高效模型协作的关键设计（交接方向与上下文传递），以在保持任务准确性的同时大幅降低成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AgentBaton, which systematically investigates key design choices for collaboration between capable and efficient models via model handoffs in long-horizon agentic tasks, substantially reducing cost while preserving task accuracy.
